  "literal": "هل لديك حليب؟",
  "adaptation": "عندك لبن؟",
  "back_translation": "Do you have milk?",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Used the punchy Egyptian colloquial 'عندك لبن؟' and specifically chose 'لبن' (laban) for milk, which is essential because 'حليب' (haleeb) sounds unnaturally formal in Egypt, while 'laban' means yogurt in most other Arab dialects."
}
